name: OSV.dev (Open Source Vulnerabilities)
summary: Aggregated open-source vulnerability database queryable by package/version or commit.
description: Distributed vulnerability DB in the OSV schema aggregating GitHub Advisories, PyPI, RustSec, Go, npm, Debian, Alpine, Linux kernel and more. Query by package + version (or purl/commit) to get affected vulnerabilities, with batch query support.

rate_limit.summary: No documented hard limit; 32 MiB request cap; batch up to 1000 queries

endpoints.summary: Get one vulnerability record by ID

license.name: Mostly CC-BY 4.0 / CC0 depending on source

agent_notes: Main entry point is POST /query with package name, ecosystem and version (or a commit). Use /querybatch for many packages and GET /vulns/{id} to fetch a record by ID.
caveats: No official OpenAPI document at a stable URL was found.
